Bolis App

2025
Co-founder

An AI companion, emotion diary, and anonymous peer chat, built to support teen mental wellness in Kazakhstan.

Quarterfinalist, Technovation Girls 2025 · Astana Hub Recognition Award
Field note · 2025

Sketched the first version of Bolis between rehearsals, on the back of a warm-up sheet. The idea was simple — checking in on how you feel shouldn't be harder than checking your phone.

Deadliner

2026
Founder & Team Lead

A deadline- and habit-tracking app that turns university-application stress into quest waypoints for students racing the clock.

Technovation Girls 2026 Quarterfinalist · 84/90 jury score · Digital Bridge Recognition Award
Field note · 2026

Named it after the thing that used to scare me most. Somewhere between practice and the application portal, deadlines stopped being the enemy and started looking like marks on a floor — something you just learn to hit.
